subject: CareWell MAP: SDK streaming + structured outputs (MVP) — next steps
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@carewell.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: CareWell MAP: SDK streaming + structured outputs (MVP) — next steps

Hi Liam — thanks again for chatting today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have them in the MAP: 

Summary of call:
- Scope: Build an MVP integration that demos SDK-based streaming, tool calling for scheduling, and structured output JSON for clinical-summary extraction.
- Success criteria: end-to-end demo with sample dataset, <200ms median token latency at demo traffic, and structured output validated against 10 sample clinical notes.
- Target MAP close: target contract execution by 2027-04-22 (you indicated end of April procurement cadence).

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
1) Integration kickoff & environment access (owner: CareWell engineering / due: 2027-03-15) — dependency: VPN + SSO user list
2) SDK integration + basic streaming flow (owner: Redwood - Ben Carter / due: 2027-03-29) — dependency: sample data shape + API keys
3) Tool-calling prototype (scheduling flow) integrated with CareWell test calendar (owner: Redwood - Priyom Das / due: 2027-04-05)
4) Structured output schema & eval (owner: CareWell data lead & Redwood RM / due: 2027-04-12)
5) Demo prep + signoff (owners: CareWell PM + Redwood sales / due: 2027-04-19)

Action items (owner / due):
- Liam: share anonymized sample notes and a contact for SSO/VPN setup (due 2027-03-12)
- Ben: drop initial SDK integration spec and example streaming call in the shared Drive (done — attached)
- Priyom: draft tool-calling pattern and calendar connector checklist (due 2027-03-18)

Attachments: CareWell_MAP_draft_v1.pdf (MAP draft), sdk-integration-spec_v0.2.xlsx (integration checklist & example payloads)

Open questions I captured:
- Will CareWell allow a short-term sandbox token we can rotate during the prototype?
- Any regulatory constraints around PHI in sample notes for the demo?

If this looks right I'll update the MAP doc and send a short calendar invite for a kickoff next week.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0128
Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@carewell.co>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@carewell.co>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: CareWell MAP: SDK streaming + structured outputs (MVP) — next steps

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the clear breakdown. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) Sample data: we'll share a de-identified set of 25 notes by EOD Wed (2027-03-10). That will include the fields you requested (note_text, encounter_date, clinician_id). PHI: legal signoff says de-identified set is fine for prototype.

2) Sandbox tokens: security is ok with short-lived scoped tokens for a time-boxed demo environment. I will loop in our infra contact, Maya Singh, on the kickoff invite.

3) Target close: procurement flagged 2027-04-22 as a realistic target if the demo covers expected scope and SOW looks standard.

On dependencies, Procurement asked whether Redwood can provide a low-level data retention note and SOC 2 section to attach to the SOW — cc'ing procurement.

Happy to be flexible on milestone dates if Redwood needs +/- 1 week.

-Liam
Liam O'Neal
Director, Product Integrations | CareWell Health
liam.oneal@carewell.co
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@carewell.co>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CareWell MAP: SDK streaming + structured outputs (MVP) — next steps

Ben / Priyom — looping you in to assign owners and confirm dates. Below I've copied Liam's clarifications inline for visibility.

On SDK streaming (Ben): please review the attached sdk-integration-spec_v0.2.xlsx and confirm the following by Fri 2027-03-12:
- Minimal code sample (Node + Python) demonstrating client-side streaming hooks and reconnection behavior
- Example structured-output JSON schema for clinical summary (we'll propose a draft schema and a small eval harness)
- A short note on token rotation approach for sandbox tokens we can share with CareWell infra/security

On tool calling (Priyom): please scope the scheduling connector prototype and share a checklist for the calendar integration by 2027-03-18. Things to include: auth type (OAuth vs API key), rate limits, and error-handling expectations during demo traffic.

Procurement asks (Liam / Procurement): we'll produce a two-paragraph data retention statement and SOC 2 posture summary to attach to the SOW — I'll coordinate with our security folks.

I'll update the MAP doc with owners/dates and send a 30m kickoff invite for next Tue 2027-03-16 10:00 PT (TBD).

Thanks,
Vanessa

> On Tue, Mar 9, 2027 at 10:12 AM Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@carewell.co> wrote:
> > Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the clear breakdown. A couple of clarifications from our side: 
> > ...
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@carewell.co>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CareWell MAP: SDK streaming + structured outputs (MVP) — next steps

All — quick update from my side after reviewing the spec: 

- I uploaded a tiny SDK demo repo link in the shared Drive (see related links) and attached a one-page readme in the Drive folder. The attached sdk-integration-spec_v0.2.xlsx includes sample payloads and a proposed structured-output schema.
- For the sandbox token approach: we'll provide scoped, short-lived tokens (24h) with a rotation script; Priyom and I will draft the technical note for procurement.
- Risk: if CareWell's VPN provisioning slips beyond 2027-03-18 we should move the SDK due date +1 week. I'll flag this in the MAP doc.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Ben: finish sample Node + Python streaming snippets and push to Drive (due 2027-03-12)
- Priyom: calendar connector checklist draft (due 2027-03-18)
- Vanessa: send kickoff calendar once we confirm IAM contact (Maya Singh)

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
